description: This Java class defines an ADSR envelope generator for audio synthesis, modeling the attack, decay, sustain, and release phases with linear ramps.

classes.name: EnvelopeADSR
classes.description: A class implementing a simple linear ADSR envelope for synthesizing audio signals.

methods.name: setAttackTime
methods.description: Sets the attack time with a minimum enforced value.

methods.name: setDecayTime
methods.description: Sets the decay time with a minimum enforced value.

methods.name: setSustainLevel
methods.description: Sets the sustain level of the envelope.

methods.name: setReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets the release time with a minimum enforced value.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Starts the attack phase of the envelope.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Starts the release phase of the envelope.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current envelope value based on the phase.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the envelope has finished releasing.
